Most words arrive by catching them mid-conversation. These are for when you want to push ahead.

One per line: word | meaning | context sentence. Context is optional. This is the format I hand back after mining an article, a transcript, or your couldn't-say notes.

Things you couldn't say

Send these to me in chat and I'll turn them into Dutch you can actually use — then add them back here as words or phrases.

You

Used in the scenes when someone asks what you are called. Stays in this browser; nothing here is sent anywhere.

Who's in your life

The scenes have a fixed cast, and each person keeps the gender the scenes give them. Rename any of them and every conversation uses your name instead. Leave a row alone to keep the original. Stored in this browser only.

More people and places
Practice
Model

The scenes, drills, words and rehearsal are fixed and need no model. Four optional extras ask one: free-form conversation, goals, custom scenes and bulk meaning fill.

Your key, not the app's. It is kept in this browser only, in plain text, sent only to the provider you picked, and left out of backups. Use a key with a spend limit, and clear it on a shared device. Inside a Claude artifact you don't need one.

Models (advanced)

Leave both empty to use the built-in model names. Providers retire models from time to time; if Test says a model was not found, put a current name here.

Use a proxy instead of a key

A proxy you run, which holds the key (see the README). Never put a key in this box. Used before the key above when both are set.

Backup & storage

Your words live in this browser. Download a copy to keep it safe or move it to another device — restoring merges instead of overwriting.

You opened this as a file on your computer. Some browsers tie your progress to this file's location, so moving or renaming it can make the app forget your words. Use one browser, and download a backup before you move the file or switch to a newer version.
